name: Illustrious Anime Mixes
author: various
description: Five community-requested Illustrious SDXL mixes, each with a look of its own: SilvermoonMix v6 V-pred (soft, pale and airy, neutral for artist tags), JANKU v7.77 (bright and clean, thicker lines), dims2 Personal Merge v3.0 (bright, glossy cel shading), ReedXXX v16 (warm, saturated, golden light) and DREAMBOX v4.5 (flat, bold-outlined illustration with retro poster colour). Prompt with Danbooru tags. Each card is its own 6.5 GB checkpoint and uses its author's own settings.

presets.name: SilvermoonMix v6.0 V-pred
presets.description:
Soft, pale, airy anime with gentle pastel light and thin line work. Next to the other Illustrious cards it is the lightest and calmest. The author made it neutral on purpose, so artist tags change it more than most, and says it is good at hands and at pictures with several characters.

Use Danbooru tags. The author's sample pictures use no quality tags and no negative prompt, so this card adds neither; add a negative prompt only if you need one.

This card uses the author's Euler a with the Simple scheduler at 28 steps and CFG 4.5.

About 15 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card.

presets.name: JANKU v7.77
presets.description:
Bright, clean anime with thicker outlines and detailed backgrounds, and wider framing than most anime cards. The author built v7.77 on JANKU and Chenkin to make Chenkin's pictures steadier.

Use Danbooru tags. The card adds masterpiece, best quality, amazing quality, very aesthetic, absurdres, newest to the start of your prompt, so you don't need to type them. The author notes v7.77 knows fewer artists than earlier JANKU versions.

This card uses the author's Euler a with the Simple scheduler at 30 steps and CFG 4.5. The author's sample pictures add their Lazy Embeddings, which this card does not use.

About 17 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card.

presets.name: dims2 Personal Merge v3.0
presets.description:
Bright, glossy cel-shaded anime with clear colour and clean skies. It is a NoobAI-based merge with hands and bodies taken from CyberRealistic XL. On busy two-person prompts it can mix up hair colours, so describe each person clearly.

Use Danbooru tags. The card adds the author's quality tags (masterpiece, best quality, amazing quality, very aesthetic, absurdres) to the start of your prompt, so you don't need to type them.

This card uses Euler a with the SGM Uniform scheduler at 28 steps and CFG 5.5. The author's sample pictures use a special sampler and a speed LoRA at 18 steps, which this card does not.

About 15 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card.

presets.name: ReedXXX v16.0
presets.description:
Warm, saturated anime with golden light and rich colour. The author says v16 gets head-to-shoulder proportions and body perspective more stable than earlier versions. When a prompt names no outfit it tends to draw very little clothing, so name what the person wears.

Use Danbooru tags; the author uses WAI-style character tags. The card adds masterpiece, best quality, amazing quality, absurdres to the start of your prompt and the author's negative prompt, so you don't need to type them.

This card uses the author's Euler with the Normal scheduler at 30 steps and CFG 5.

About 17 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card.

presets.name: DREAMBOX v4.5
presets.description:
Often a flat illustration with bold outlines and retro poster colour, more like a picture book or a comic than anime, which makes it the least like the other Illustrious cards; on some prompts (a knight in our test) it gives ordinary glossy anime instead. In our test it once swapped two characters' outfits, so describe each person clearly.

Use Danbooru tags or plain English. The card adds best quality, masterpiece, absurdres, newest to the start of your prompt. The author trained over 100 style trigger words into the model; the Civitai page lists them, and mixing them gives different looks.

This card uses the author's DPM++ 2M SDE with the SGM Uniform scheduler at CFG 5, at 24 steps. The author's sample pictures add a hi-res pass, which this card does not run.

About 15 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card.
